title: AI analysis
description: Get a second opinion on these scan results.
hubDescription: Sends Codex, under your sign-in, only scan metadata or recording measurements, and only when you start an analysis from a tool.
hubPrivacy: Scans share only anonymous file metadata. Recordings share numeric CPU, memory and disk measurements with temporary process IDs. Names, paths, notes and file contents stay on this device.
connectionIntro: Use Codex on this computer. Check the connection, then choose a tool below.
connected: Codex is connected and ready for metadata-only analysis.
scanFirst: Run a scan first. AI analysis becomes available when its results are ready.
anotherRunning: Another AI analysis is already running. You can find it in Preferences → AI analysis.
continuesInBackground: Analysis continues while you use other views. Return here to see the result.
hubInstructions: Complete a scan or save a performance recording, enable its AI analysis, then start it with the dedicated button. Nothing is sent automatically.

cleaner.title: System cleanup
cleaner.dataSent: Temporary IDs, file type, size and approximate age. Privacy traces excluded.

largeFiles.title: Large files
largeFiles.dataSent: Temporary IDs, file type, size and approximate age.

duplicates.title: Duplicate files
duplicates.dataSent: Temporary IDs, file type, size, approximate age and duplicate group.

disk.title: Disk analysis
disk.dataSent: Temporary IDs, total folder size and approximate age.

performance.title: Performance recordings
performance.dataSent: Numeric CPU, memory and disk measurements, with temporary process IDs.

enable: Enable AI analysis for this view
privacy: Only temporary IDs, generic file types, sizes, and approximate file ages are sent. Names, paths, hashes, and file contents stay on this device.
accessCaveat: Last access is filesystem metadata. It may be missing or changed by another app, and does not prove when you last opened a file.
diskAggregation: A folder row represents its total size. It does not reveal which files inside the folder should be reviewed.
codexMissing: Install Codex on this computer to use AI analysis.
unsupportedVersion: This Codex version cannot provide the required metadata-only privacy boundary. Use the supported Codex 0.157.1 version.
unsafeConfiguration: The current Codex configuration cannot guarantee metadata-only analysis. Review your local Codex configuration before trying again.
signIn: Open Codex on this computer and sign in to use AI analysis.
unavailable: AI analysis is unavailable right now. Check Codex on this computer and try again.
omitted: {{count}} more items were left out of this analysis.
failed: The analysis could not be completed. Try again.
advisory: Review these suggestions yourself. AI analysis never selects or deletes files.
